gap.title: Find a linear space of 4 x 5 complex matrices, of dimension 5, whose members have all row and column sums zero and vanishing sums of subpermanents of each size; it may not exist
gap.statement: ∃ L : Submodule ℂ (Fin 4 × Fin 5 → ℂ), (∀ t ∈ L, (∀ i : Fin 4, ∑ j, t (i, j) = 0) ∧ (∀ j : Fin 5, ∑ i, t (i, j) = 0) ∧ (∑ j, ∑ l, if j = l then 0 else ∑ a : Fin 4, ∑ b : Fin 4, if a < b then t (a, j) * t (b, l) else 0) = 0 ∧ (∑ j, ∑ l, ∑ m, if j = l ∨ j = m ∨ l = m then 0 else ∑ a : Fin 4, ∑ b : Fin 4, ∑ c : Fin 4, if a < b ∧ b < c then t (a, j) * t (b, l) * t (c, m) else 0) = 0 ∧ (∑ j, ∑ l, ∑ m, ∑ n, if j = l ∨ j = m ∨ j = n ∨ l = m ∨ l = n ∨ m = n then 0 else t (0, j) * t (1, l) * t (2, m) * t (3, n)) = 0) ∧ Module.finrank ℂ L = 5
gap.unlocks: the largest doubly centred level space at 4 x 5, a core case of the dimension bound
gap.context: Needed by seat-barrier-1 for the four-row step and the core maxima of the level-space dimension bound. A witness is checked by evaluation. The largest known has dimension 4; a proof that none exists is equally wanted.
